scientific_integrity: Published irreducibility lemma and construction are credited to Asgarli–Ghioca; singularity and rational point classifications are new assertions supported by a general proof and independent finite-field checks. Same-model review only; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Specific four-dimensional Frobenius-twisted plane-cubic linear system only; no classification of arbitrary cubic systems.
No uniform point count for smooth members; no classification of full zeta functions or geometric isomorphism classes.
Singular parameter equation is a set-theoretic characterization on rational parameters, not a discriminant scheme multiplicity theorem.
Historical priority may be affected by previously unindexed equivalent calculations.
title: Exact singular and arithmetic strata in a Frobenius-twisted cubic linear system
